chart.title: Share of countries with independent national human rights institutions
chart.subtitle: Independent national human rights institutions are self-governing administrative bodies set up by the respective country to promote and protect human rights. These institutions must meet the UN’s standards in order to be counted here.
chart.citation: United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and Global Alliance of National Human Rights Institutions
selection: Northern Africa and Western Asia (UN SDG)
